findings.text: follow-on: `_store_temporary` re-implements the store's temporary-name predicate rather than extending an owner; the identical expression `entry.name.startswith(".") and entry.name.endswith(".tmp")` already stands at tests/test_runs_pointer_writer_reuses_the_store.py:80 and tests/test_supervisor_write_reuses_the_store.py:85, and no shared owner exists (reckon/_store.py creates the temporary at :508 but exposes no predicate for recognising it). This is the third copy of one idiom; a fourth test needing it will copy it again. Not blocking: the one-line body is correct and matches the store's own naming, and there is no obvious shared home for it today.

follow-on: excluding every name of the store's temporary form from the listing arm also exempts a genuine leak written under that name, so a case that wrote `.<name>.<pid>.<token>.tmp` into the real live-pointer directory and left it there is now unreported by the listing arm. The narrowing is the necessary cost of the fix (the store publishes pointers through exactly this name), and the needle arm at :159 still reports such a file when it carries a minted id, so the residual is small; recorded because it is a real reduction in the arm's coverage rather than a defect in the change.
